response.original_title: The Most Dangerous Job in Wrestling | Inside Mexico's Lucha Libre
response.overview: Where masked wrestlers put their bodies on the line every time they enter the ring. Behind the colorful masks, larger-than-life characters and roaring crowds lies a dangerous profession built on pain, sacrifice and an extraordinary dedication to the sport. This documentary follows the men behind the masks. It reveals what it really takes to make a living as a professional wrestler in Mexico — from punishing fights and serious injuries to the passion and tradition that keep them coming back to the ring. A raw look inside one of wrestling’s most fascinating and dangerous worlds.
response.tagline: Step inside the brutal and spectacular world of Mexican Lucha Libre.
response.title: The Most Dangerous Job in Wrestling | Inside Mexico's Lucha Libre
